description: Data-supported V4 demand-flexibility scenario: existing BAIT +/-1 C thermal envelopes, non-negative continuous thermal service inventories, and aggregate EV service inventory tied exactly to 25% of the existing EV charging baseline. It is not Base; V1G is the central case.

parameter_status.thermal_service: The accepted Power_curve_V2 BAIT +/-1 C envelope is scaled by explicit 25% heating and 20% cooling enrollment. The state is non-negative and continuous over the selected horizon; no comfort debt or daily reset is allowed.
parameter_status.ev_mobility: The existing EV charging baseline is split into 75% immutable and 25% schedulable service. The latter has exact hourly energy withdrawal and one-day aggregate inventory. No connection probability, trip chain or departure SOC is fabricated; ev_hour_weight is used only through the existing baseline.
parameter_status.enablement_cost: Enablement and activation prices are explicit engineering scenario assumptions with registered low/high ranges.
parameter_status.v2g_scope: V1G is the central V4 case. V2G remains only the separate V4 sensitivity.
